final_answer:
CC-26-022 lists only SOP-MFG-104, and that is far from enough. Raising the target MOI to 8.0 TU/cell takes it outside the 4.0–6.0 range that the EBR enforces and that PPQ-001 qualified. I found two mismatches in the records, plus two checks that can be closed on existing evidence.

**The change control's own impact assessment**
- CC-26-022 is MAJOR, status IMPACT ASSESSMENT, with no implementation date.
- Its only link is IMPACTS → SOP-MFG-104.
- It names no EBR specification, risk assessment, PPQ protocol or test.

**Revise, re-assess, re-test or revalidate**

| Item | Action | In CC impact assessment? |
|---|---|---|
| SOP-MFG-104 (Lentiviral transduction, v2.0) | Revise the MOI instructions. It is linked to FM-05, FM-06 and FM-08 as a control. | Yes |
| URS-EBR-009 | Revise "Target MOI outside 4.0–6.0 TU/cell shall be rejected for GMP runs". As written, the EBR would reject an MOI of 8.0. It is rated HIGH by FRA-042. | **No** |
| CS-EBR-03 | Reconfigure the EBR range check, which is currently a hard stop at 4.0–6.0 TU/cell, to the new range. | **No** |
| New or updated EBR range-check test in OQ-EBR-01 | Add a SCRIPTED test and execute it after the reconfiguration. No test case verifies URS-EBR-009 or CS-EBR-03 today, and HIGH-risk requirements need a SCRIPTED test. | **No** |
| FRA-042 | Re-assess, because it is the HIGH risk assessment of the URS-EBR-009 range check. | **No** |
| PPQ-001, criterion 1 (MOI 4.0–6.0 TU/cell, CPP) | Revise the protocol and requalify. All 5 PPQ batches (PPQ26-01 to -05) ran at MOI 5.0, and the PPQ-001 report is still pending. 8.0 is outside the qualified range, so a PPQ addendum or supplemental PPQ runs at 8.0 are needed. | **No** |
| PPQ-001 criteria 8, 9 and 12 (%CAR+ ≥20, VCN ≤5.0 copies per CAR+ cell, potency ≥1000) | Re-evaluate these CQAs at MOI 8.0 in the supplemental runs. | **No** |
| FM-05 (MOI above target, sev 9, HIGH) | Re-assess in RA-PFMEA-001. The excess-integration effect on VCN is now more relevant. | **No** |
| FM-06 (MOI below target, sev 8, HIGH) | Re-assess in RA-PFMEA-001. It affects %CAR+ and potency, and the "target" has changed. | **No** |

Two related risk items I would also review, though their link to the MOI change is weaker:
- **FM-07 (vector storage temperature):** higher MOI means more vector is consumed.
- **FM-14 (VCN calculation in LIMS):** VCN values will be higher, but see the LIMS check below.

**Checks that need no retest, based on current evidence**
- **Vector volume calculation (URS-EBR-007, CS-EBR-02, FRA-040):** the specifications don't change. TC-OQ-EBR-04 (execution TX-0083, PASS) challenged 2.5–10.0 TU/cell, which already covers 8.0. I would only document a regression assessment.
- **LIMS VCN calculation (TC-OQ-LIMS-04):** it was tested to 8.0 copies/cell.
- **VCN method AM-VCN:** its validated range is 0.1–6.0 copies/cell.
- **Expected VCN at MOI 8.0:** the PD DoE runs (DOE-MOI-01/02/03, MOI 2.5 to 15) show per-CAR+ VCN of about 2.1–2.5 at MOI 5 and about 3.0–3.3 at MOI 10. At MOI 15 it is 4.7–5.0, just under the ≤5.0 limit. Interpolating gives roughly 2.8 at MOI 8.0, comfortably within the limit.
- **%CAR+ and potency:** %CAR+ rises from about 39% at MOI 5 to about 65% at MOI 10, so the change supports the stated aim. The DoE data are non-GMP PD runs only, so they support the rationale but do not replace PPQ.

The vector lots (LV25-104, LV25-118, LV26-007, LV26-021) are all RELEASED and unexpired. I did not find a reason to open anything else for the vector lots.

content.text:
CC-26-022 lists only SOP-MFG-104, and that is far from enough. Raising the target MOI to 8.0 TU/cell takes it outside the 4.0–6.0 range that the EBR enforces and that PPQ-001 qualified. I found two mismatches in the records, plus two checks that can be closed on existing evidence.

**The change control's own impact assessment**
- CC-26-022 is MAJOR, status IMPACT ASSESSMENT, with no implementation date.
- Its only link is IMPACTS → SOP-MFG-104.
- It names no EBR specification, risk assessment, PPQ protocol or test.

**Revise, re-assess, re-test or revalidate**

| Item | Action | In CC impact assessment? |
|---|---|---|
| SOP-MFG-104 (Lentiviral transduction, v2.0) | Revise the MOI instructions. It is linked to FM-05, FM-06 and FM-08 as a control. | Yes |
| URS-EBR-009 | Revise "Target MOI outside 4.0–6.0 TU/cell shall be rejected for GMP runs". As written, the EBR would reject an MOI of 8.0. It is rated HIGH by FRA-042. | **No** |
| CS-EBR-03 | Reconfigure the EBR range check, which is currently a hard stop at 4.0–6.0 TU/cell, to the new range. | **No** |
| New or updated EBR range-check test in OQ-EBR-01 | Add a SCRIPTED test and execute it after the reconfiguration. No test case verifies URS-EBR-009 or CS-EBR-03 today, and HIGH-risk requirements need a SCRIPTED test. | **No** |
| FRA-042 | Re-assess, because it is the HIGH risk assessment of the URS-EBR-009 range check. | **No** |
| PPQ-001, criterion 1 (MOI 4.0–6.0 TU/cell, CPP) | Revise the protocol and requalify. All 5 PPQ batches (PPQ26-01 to -05) ran at MOI 5.0, and the PPQ-001 report is still pending. 8.0 is outside the qualified range, so a PPQ addendum or supplemental PPQ runs at 8.0 are needed. | **No** |
| PPQ-001 criteria 8, 9 and 12 (%CAR+ ≥20, VCN ≤5.0 copies per CAR+ cell, potency ≥1000) | Re-evaluate these CQAs at MOI 8.0 in the supplemental runs. | **No** |
| FM-05 (MOI above target, sev 9, HIGH) | Re-assess in RA-PFMEA-001. The excess-integration effect on VCN is now more relevant. | **No** |
| FM-06 (MOI below target, sev 8, HIGH) | Re-assess in RA-PFMEA-001. It affects %CAR+ and potency, and the "target" has changed. | **No** |

Two related risk items I would also review, though their link to the MOI change is weaker:
- **FM-07 (vector storage temperature):** higher MOI means more vector is consumed.
- **FM-14 (VCN calculation in LIMS):** VCN values will be higher, but see the LIMS check below.

**Checks that need no retest, based on current evidence**
- **Vector volume calculation (URS-EBR-007, CS-EBR-02, FRA-040):** the specifications don't change. TC-OQ-EBR-04 (execution TX-0083, PASS) challenged 2.5–10.0 TU/cell, which already covers 8.0. I would only document a regression assessment.
- **LIMS VCN calculation (TC-OQ-LIMS-04):** it was tested to 8.0 copies/cell.
- **VCN method AM-VCN:** its validated range is 0.1–6.0 copies/cell.
- **Expected VCN at MOI 8.0:** the PD DoE runs (DOE-MOI-01/02/03, MOI 2.5 to 15) show per-CAR+ VCN of about 2.1–2.5 at MOI 5 and about 3.0–3.3 at MOI 10. At MOI 15 it is 4.7–5.0, just under the ≤5.0 limit. Interpolating gives roughly 2.8 at MOI 8.0, comfortably within the limit.
- **%CAR+ and potency:** %CAR+ rises from about 39% at MOI 5 to about 65% at MOI 10, so the change supports the stated aim. The DoE data are non-GMP PD runs only, so they support the rationale but do not replace PPQ.

The vector lots (LV25-104, LV25-118, LV26-007, LV26-021) are all RELEASED and unexpired. I did not find a reason to open anything else for the vector lots.
